content: We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no molecule given. Possibly the sample at hand is implicit? We need to get carbon NMR spectra? But aromatic carbons can be identified from carbon NMR. However we don't have SMILES. Maybe the system expects to call carbon_nmr_spectra to get spectra and then infer number of aromatic carbons. But we don't know the molecule. Could be that the environment has a sample loaded. So we should call carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR data. Then count aromatic carbon signals. Typically aromatic carbons appear around 110-160 ppm. We'll need to parse the output. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
